does: Walks three entity queries of modified components and, per character view model, writes IsPlayableCharacter (+0x528) from the component's byte +0x30, and makes the player properties (unplaced::GetOrCreatePlayerCharacterProperties) when it turns true; runs only for a modified component, so a view model made after the change never learns it.

evidence.says: The decompiled body: QueryIterator over Modified/Alive, +0x528 compared and written with DeferPropertyChanged, then the +0x420 creation.
The Toolkit's gui::ViewModelProvider::UpdateIsPlayableCharacter writes the same flag (+0x540 there) from eoc::party::MemberComponent and eoc::PlayerComponent.

Headless from the process start the host's VMCharacter has IsPlayableCharacter false and OwnerPlayerId 0; replicating the host's PartyMember and Player from the server (a modification) set it true and the dialogue window filled.
